200.body: The U.S. has begun training Polish special forces in drone tactics based on Ukraine’s experience Kyiv • UNN August 30 2026, 08:45 PM • 1986 views American Green Berets are training Polish special forces in Germany to use drones based on Ukrainian experience. American "Green Berets" in Germany are training Polish special forces in new drone tactics developed based on Ukraine's experience of confronting Russian forces. It was previously tested twice by U.S. special forces, and now, for the first time, troops from another NATO country have been involved in the training. 300.title: The summer that scorched French grapes, English gardens—and Europe’s economy
300.summary: Global The summer that scorched French grapes, English gardens—and Europe’s economy David Luhnow , Stacy Meichtry , Ed Ballard , The Wall Street Journal 12 min read 31 Aug 2026, 06:53 AM IST The shifting climate is rapidly changing life in Europe, leading to unprecedented heatwaves, droughts, and wildfires.
300.body: Global The summer that scorched French grapes, English gardens—and Europe’s economy David Luhnow , Stacy Meichtry , Ed Ballard , The Wall Street Journal 12 min read 31 Aug 2026, 06:53 AM IST The shifting climate is rapidly changing life in Europe, leading to unprecedented heatwaves, droughts, and wildfires. The summer also doubled the previous record number of days above 34 degrees Celsius, or 93 Fahrenheit—14 versus seven in 1976, the year of a notorious heat wave. The water saved the young vines, but the heat ripened the château’s grapes faster, forcing Perrin to start harvesting in early August, three weeks early. The combination of heat waves, drought and wildfires is expected to cost France, the EU’s second largest economy, up to €15 billion, or 0.5% of GDP, according to French Environment Minister Monique Barbut.

300.title: Northern Europe HRC prices extend gains; Italian market quiet amid supply constraints
300.summary: Northern Europe HRC prices extend gains; Italian market quiet amid supply constraints 31 August 2026 The hot-rolled coil market in Northern Europe continued to show positive momentum through the week ending Friday August 28, with market sources reporting higher tradeable levels and offers.
300.body: Northern Europe HRC prices extend gains; Italian market quiet amid supply constraints 31 August 2026 The hot-rolled coil market in Northern Europe continued to show positive momentum through the week ending Friday August 28, with market sources reporting higher tradeable levels and offers. The Italian market was comparatively quieter amid supply constraints, while some market participants believed this would soon result in Italian prices matching those in Northern Europe. The most recent indications of tradeable levels in Northern Europe varied within a wide range of €730-750 ($850-874) per tonne ex-works. In Italy, the market leader was said to raise offers to €750 per tonne delivered or €735 per tonne ex-works; however, the most recent tradeable levels varied within the range of €710-720 per tonne ex-works.

600.title: OT drama: World champs Germany snap Poland's unbeaten streak
600.summary: Official App Latest news, notifications and live scores Download Now GDANSK (Poland) - Reigning world champions Germany ended Poland’s unbeaten run after claiming a 96-94 overtime victory in the FIBA Basketball World Cup European Qualifiers.
600.body: Official App Latest news, notifications and live scores Download Now GDANSK (Poland) - Reigning world champions Germany ended Poland’s unbeaten run after claiming a 96-94 overtime victory in the FIBA Basketball World Cup European Qualifiers. Germany delivered a composed, clinical performance from start to finish, ending Poland’s impressive seven-game winning streak with flawless execution when it mattered most - and to put any pending qualification party on ice. Germany have now continued their strong run of form as they look to build toward next summer’s FIBA Basketball World Cup in Qatar, where they will attempt to defend the title they won in 2023. Mateusz Ponitka was Poland’s standout performer, finishing with 20 points, 8 rebounds and 5 assists as the hosts battled to stay within reach and nearly took it to double overtime.
